stories.headline: Anchorage, Kalshi bet on crypto collateral for trading

stories.headline: Fed officials expect more rate hikes, worry about AI impact on inflation, minutes show
stories.body: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released minutes from its October policy meeting at which it voted to hold its benchmark interest rate in a range between 3.75%-4%.
